exposure: maternal age at first cesarean delivery
cesarean deliveries after onset of labor
cohort: Women over 18 years old who underwent two cesarean deliveries between 1988 and 2016 at a large tertiary medical center
finding: Maternal age 35 years or older at the first cesarean delivery, Bedouin Arab ethnicity, composite of intrapartum and postpartum infectious morbidity, and cesarean deliveries performed after the onset of labor were significantly associated with peritoneal adhesions, while previous vaginal birth was protective.
